I wish I had taken a short video before using it so you can see how bendable they were. On the box it says that longer, stronger, thick nails in just three days and I can definitely say that they are stronger.
Glides on easily and dries fast.  I put two coats on as a base. My nails are longer, stronger and resist splits, chips, and breaking.

I had trouble growing my nails out with them constantly splitting at the edges. Not anymore! This product works very well! I just had split, fine nails that wouldn’t grow until I started using this product. Now I have to trim them often to keep them at a manageable length. I have been using this product for over a year now and will continue to do so. They started growing out almost instantly.

This wasn't an instant thickener/hardener like I had hoped. (I can use shellac gel polish or dipping powder for that.) But what I LOVED about this product was that it doesn't peel off like most of the other nail strengtheners that I have tried. I have a handful of those others still in my cabinet. Because this goes on clear, even tho it has a sheen, my husband can use it, especially in the winter when his nails split, crack, and snag on things. In fact, this reorder is at his request.   my cabin

claims.text: Many reviewers report their nails became noticeably harder, stronger, or thicker after using the product, often within a few days.
Reviewers frequently mention that the product helped their damaged, thin, or weak nails (often from acrylics or gel) grow without splitting or breaking.
Several reviewers praise the product for delivering results after other strengtheners and treatments failed.
A few reviewers note the product protects nails by forming a strong coating rather than actually thickening the natural nail.
One reviewer reports the product did not strengthen or harden their nails and breakage continued.

qa.q: Does it actually make nails thicker?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree: some say it makes nails look thicker and stronger [3][4][5], while others say it does not thicken the actual nail and only adds a protective coating [1][2].

claims.text: Some reviewers report their nails became thicker and stronger after use.
Other reviewers say it does not make the actual nail thicker and only provides a protective armor or acts like clear polish.

qa.q: How long does the shine last?
qa.answer: Not enough evidence in reviews to answer this.

qa.q: Will it help with peeling or splitting nails?
qa.answer: Yes, multiple reviewers report it helped with peeling and splitting nails [1][2][3][6]. However, one reviewer says it did not strengthen their nails and they still bend [5].

claims.text: Reviewers report reduced peeling and splitting after use.
One reviewer says the product did not strengthen their nails and they still bend.

qa.q: Does it have a strong smell?
qa.answer: Only one review addresses smell, stating it "doesn't smell unpleasant once it dries" [3]. No other reviews comment on the strength of the scent.

claims.text: It doesn't smell unpleasant once it dries.

qa.answer: Reviews disagree on value: some call it a waste of money and say cheaper alternatives work as well [1][5], while others call it inexpensive for the results and a great value [2][4].

claims.text: Some reviewers say it was a waste of money and not worth it, suggesting cheaper alternatives work as well.
Other reviewers describe it as inexpensive for the results and a great value.
